messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-07-04] handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-20 handover: the new owner of the webhooks service is Dune. Ember was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04-2: As before, the webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. Reminder: webhooks is owned by team Dune.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2025-05-23] standup/ember/2025-05-23: The Ember team saw that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2: Heads-up from Atlas: the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-06-20] handover/2025-06-20-webhooks: Webhooks has a new home: Ember. Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-05-05] standup/dune/2025-05-05: For newcomers: the deploy window for the catalog is still on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-05-05] standup/boreal/2025-05-05: Reminder that the billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2025-03-28] handover/2025-03-28-webhooks: From today the pager for the webhooks service rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-04] standup/dune/2025-04-04: We agreed today that the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. The reason is that the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-05-09] standup/atlas/2025-05-09: Reminder from Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-05-09] standup/dune/2025-05-09-2: The Dune team has switched to a monthly game day.
- [2025-04-29] standup/cinder/2025-04-29: For anything Cinder-related, page Yuki.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-04-08] standup/dune/2025-04-08: Reminder that the reporting service depends on the ledger.
- [2025-05-09] standup/dune/2025-05-09: Reporting must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: If image-resizer is down, the product catalog is down: it relies on it for thumbnails.
- [2025-05-08] standup/boreal/2025-05-08: Boreal saw that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-25] standup/boreal/2025-02-25: Webhooks still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-12-05] standup/cinder/2025-12-05: Team change: Diego Alvarez leaves team Cinder and joins Ember, effective today.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-04-07] standup/atlas/2025-04-07: Team Atlas on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-11-04] standup/boreal/2025-11-04: No deploys to the billing API from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18: Per the change policy, Ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-16] standup/boreal/2025-04-16: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus Oyelaran hands the pager to Lena Fischer.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25: Marcus picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2: Team Cinder noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18: Oskar Lind picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-04-09] standup/cinder/2025-04-09: On-call rotation: Yuki Tanaka is primary for the Cinder team starting today; Diego Alvarez is off rotation.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.

Question: Who was responsible for webhooks on 2025-04-05?
